title: Grayscale Adds BitGo To Hyperliquid Staking ETF Custody Setup
summary: Grayscale has added BitGo Bank & Trust as an additional custodian for a portion of the HYPE held by its Hyperliquid Staking ETF. The SEC filing shows how increasingly complex altcoin and staking products are building institutional custody structures around assets that once traded almost entirely inside crypto-native venues.

title: Avalanche Tokenized Treasury Market Reaches $545 Million After Rapid Growth
summary: Tokenized US Treasury assets on Avalanche have reached roughly $545 million, according to data highlighted this week. The segment has expanded about fourfold over the past year, adding another example of institutional financial products moving onto public blockchain infrastructure.

title: Metaplanet Sold 10,000 Bitcoin, Then Bought 11,000 Back. Here’s Why
summary: Metaplanet disclosed that it sold 10,000 BTC during the third quarter for roughly $790 million before buying 11,000 BTC for around $950 million. The company says the exercise was designed to demonstrate that its Bitcoin treasury can provide liquidity when required, while leaving it with a net increase of 1,000 BTC.

title: Arbitrum DAO Weighs 100 Million ARB Push To Make USDG A Core Stablecoin
summary: Arbitrum has joined Paxos’ Global Dollar Network, and a new DAO proposal asks the community to back USDG as a strategic stablecoin for the ecosystem. The plan includes adding 100 million ARB to the DRIP incentive budget to support liquidity, integrations and adoption.

title: Winklevoss Zcash ETF Filing Brings Privacy Coin Exposure To Nasdaq
summary: Winklevoss Asset Services has filed an S-1 with the SEC for the Winklevoss Zcash ETF, a proposed Nasdaq-listed product designed to hold ZEC directly. The preliminary prospectus sets a 0.25% sponsor fee, while Winklevoss Capital has indicated nonbinding interest in purchasing up to $100 million of shares.

title: Ethereum ETFs Lose $201.9 Million As Bitcoin Funds Return To Inflows
summary: US spot Ethereum ETFs recorded $201.9 million in net outflows on October 6, according to Farside Investors. Bitcoin ETFs moved the other way with roughly $118.8 million of net inflows, creating a sharp one-day divergence between institutional flows into the two largest crypto assets.

title: Ethereum Tests 200 Million Gas Limit On Sepolia As Glamsterdam Moves Forward
summary: Ethereum’s Sepolia testnet is testing a 200 million block gas limit as part of work around the Glamsterdam upgrade. The experiment is more than three times Sepolia’s previous 60 million target and is intended to show how clients and validators behave under much heavier Layer 1 execution loads.

title: Cardano Brings Compliance Rules On-Chain With CIP-0113 Launch
summary: Cardano’s CIP-0113 programmable token standard is now live on mainnet. It gives issuers the ability to build controls such as KYC requirements, sanctions screening and transfer restrictions directly into native Cardano assets, targeting regulated stablecoins, funds and tokenized securities.

title: Ripple Prime Expands Brevan Howard Deal Into Multi-Asset Clearing And Financing
summary: Ripple has expanded its relationship with global investment manager Brevan Howard, with Ripple Prime now providing multi-asset prime brokerage, clearing and financing services to Brevan Howard funds. The agreement pushes Ripple further into institutional market infrastructure spanning both traditional and digital assets.

title: Robinhood Puts $25 Million Of Bitcoin On Its Own Balance Sheet
summary: Robinhood has added $25 million worth of Bitcoin to its corporate balance sheet, marking its first proprietary BTC holding separate from customer assets. The amount is small relative to Robinhood’s roughly $100 billion valuation, but the company says that is partly the point: the purchase is intended as a signal of alignment with Bitcoin and the wider crypto market.
